title: Stars
lyrics: To reach me [G]now; You reach me [F]now.
You should see the moon in flight,
Reach me now; You reach me now.
You should feel the sun in spring,
I can feel it now; I feel You now.
You should hear the angels sing,
More beautiful than you could dream.
You can hear them now; I hear them now.
And how could such a King
And how could such a King shine His light on me
I want to [G]shine; I want to be light.
I want to tell You, '[F]it'll be alright.'
And I want to [G]shine, and I want to fly,
Just to tell You, 'n[F]ow it'll be alright.'
[G]'Cause I've got nothing of my o[F]wn to give to You.
[G]But this light that shines on [F]me shines on You
It'll be al[C]righ[Csus]t; It'll be al[C]right.
